expectations.text: Seek wealth, not money or status (with definitions: assets that earn while you sleep)
expectations.evidence: Section 1 defines wealth as 'assets that earn while you sleep', money and status separately

expectations.text: Specific knowledge: cannot be trained for; found through genuine curiosity
expectations.evidence: Section 3: 'knowledge you cannot be trained for', found via 'genuine curiosity and passion'

expectations.text: Leverage: labor, capital, code and media; code and media are permissionless
expectations.evidence: Section 6 lists labor, capital, code and media; quotes 'Code and media are permissionless leverage'

expectations.text: Own equity — you won't get rich renting out your time
expectations.evidence: Section 2 quotes 'You're not going to get rich renting out your time' and says own equity

expectations.text: Accountability and/or playing long-term games with long-term people (compound interest)
expectations.evidence: Sections 4-5: long-term games with long-term people, compound interest quote; accountability under your own name

expectations.text: Productize yourself and/or 'learn to sell, learn to build' and/or judgment over hours
expectations.evidence: Sections 7-9: judgment over hours, Productize yourself, 'Learn to sell. Learn to build.'
